query: Which synthetic-data generation strategies (agent-based, generative models, bootstrapping) best preserve joint spatio-temporal distributions and higher-order metrics like cascade size and delay autocorrelation?

response.query: Which synthetic-data generation strategies (agent-based, generative models, bootstrapping) best preserve joint spatio-temporal distributions and higher-order metrics like cascade size and delay autocorrelation?
response.answer: Generative models best preserve joint spatio-temporal distributions and higher-order metrics. Agent-based models and bootstrapping have limitations in this area. Recent advances in deep learning enhance generative models' accuracy.
